name: Clip Image Localizer
description: Downloads external images in clipped notes into your EdgeEver R2 storage and rewrites Markdown to local resource URLs. Manual sync plus optional daily schedule (desktop).

fields.label: Note tag to scan
fields.description: Only notes containing this tag are included in batch sync (default: web-clip).

fields.label: Daily automatic sync
fields.description: Desktop: runs on a schedule while EdgeEver is open. Web: checks about once per day when the app stays open.

fields.label: Desktop schedule (cron)
fields.description: Cron expression for desktop scheduled sync (UTC). Example: 0 3 * * * = 03:00 UTC daily.

fields.label: Localize after new web clip
fields.description: When a note is created with the clip tag, localize its images in the background.
